decision_rule.rule: Proceed to a full 5-fold commit only if the winning rung beats baselineA_fold0_nb0_image on fold-0 TPR@FPR=1e-3 by MORE than the fold-0 paired-bootstrap CI half-width. On a tie between nb1 and nb3, prefer nb3.
decision_rule.amended_from: Original rule preferred nb1 on a tie, justified half on compute cost and half on 'partial unfreeze' being a cleaner claim.
decision_rule.amendment_rationale: Compute is no longer the binding constraint (Kaggle/Colab available), so the cost leg of the original tie-break is gone. Protocol match then wins: n_blocks=3 is Lines et al.'s exact setting, and matching it is what makes our Baseline A comparable to their published simulation-only result -- which is the entire purpose of this lever.
decision_rule.prerequisite: An nb3 commit requires gradient checkpointing implemented and tested (numerically exact; test 8 in test_encoder_unfreeze.py).
decision_rule.frozen: Do not modify this rule after seeing numbers.
